newsitem.title: UK: European bunkers weaker, some enquiry seen.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers weaker, some enquiry seen.

text.p: NWE bunker fuel prices were marked slightly weaker on bearish sentiment over increasing fuel oil supplies, but whilst bid levels dipped in sympathy in the Mediterranean offers were mostly stable.

Spot Rotterdam High sulphur fuel oil barges traded early at $97.50 and $98.25 fob ARA after which sellers disappeared. The $3 fall stirred the bunker market, launching around 10,000 tonnes of enquiries, traders said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was talked at $99/$101 fob off $2-3 a tonne with Antwerp levels holding a small $1 premium to Rotterdam liftings and Hamburg prices a $3-4 premium.

Mediterranean prices, including those in Spain and southern France, eased from Monday's $1 a tonne gains, but the weakness was seen mostly on the bid side with sellers holding levels for fuel oil steady amid fairly tight supply.

South African prices held steady with Durban stocks reported to be tightening, but dealers were unsure what effect, if any, a limited one-day illegal strike by members of the Chemical Worker's Industrial Union would have.
